task.description: Second retry of fn:git-merge per docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md, run_id WF03-ISS0262-20260822, branch feature/WF03-ISS0262-20260822. If you discover ANY NEW H6 violation (i.e. the floor-commit mechanism itself failed to grandfather a pre-existing file, or a genuinely new post-floor file that should legitimately fail), that IS a real blocker -- stop and report FAIL with full detail, do not attempt to patch the mechanism yourself.
